Write failing tests for resolve_ticket_id() function in ticket-lib.sh. Tests must be RED before T7 implementation.

Acceptance criteria (each a distinct test function):
- Given: alias input (adj-noun-noun); When: resolve_ticket_id() called; Then: returns canonical 16-hex ID
- Given: jira_key input (e.g. DSO-42); When: resolve_ticket_id() called; Then: returns canonical ID via index lookup
- Given: unique 4-char prefix; When: resolve_ticket_id() called; Then: returns canonical ID
- Given: ambiguous prefix matching 2+ tickets; When: resolve_ticket_id() called; Then: exits non-zero and lists matches to stderr
- Given: 8-hex canonical ID (xxxx-xxxx, old format, existing ticket in store); When: resolve_ticket_id() called; Then: returns the 8-hex ID as-is (backward compat — do not reject)
- Given: 16-hex canonical ID passthrough; When: resolve_ticket_id() called; Then: returns same ID unchanged

Test file: tests/scripts/test-ticket-lib.sh (add new test functions)
Story DD coverage: SC2 (multi-form resolver), backward compat with pre-migration tickets
